history.summary: Very little is documented about this temple, and the generic name makes identification ambiguous - Karnal district has several Devi shrines (including a Mansa Devi Mandir on Meerut Road, Karnal). The only web page matching 'Devi Mandir, Karnal, Haryana' (vushii.com) describes a Devi Mandir in the town of Gharaunda, Karnal district, where devotees come to seek blessings and fulfilment of wishes - so the CSV town 'Karnal' is corrected to Gharaunda (verify). Address details conflict: the page text says 'town of Gharaunda' and places it 'near the Raju Honda Service Point in Prem Nagar', but lists the address as 'MXQQ+V2C, GT Rd, Shakti Colony, Karnal, Haryana 132001' (a Karnal-city pin code). No builder, dynasty, founding date or sectarian detail is given anywhere. Coordinates are the geocoder's POI match for 'Devi Mandir, Dharmveer Colony, Gharaunda' (29.53843, 76.96679) - approximate, verify on site.

town_description: Gharaunda is a town in Karnal district, Haryana, on the GT Road corridor, known for its grain market. It lies about 15 km north of Karnal city, near the Yamuna bridge on NH 709A.
